title: Bioinformatic analysis of THAP9 transposase homolog: conserved regions, novel motifs.
authors: Rashmi, Richa; Nandi, Chandan; Majumdar, Sharmistha
one_liner_zh: 该文通过AlphaFold结构预测和进化分析表征THAP9转座酶同源蛋白的DNA结合与催化结构域，虽涉及蛋白-DNA互作但非典型TF-DNA体系，方法以结构预测为主，对TF-DNA互作建模有参考价值。
abstract: THAP9 is a transposable element-derived gene that encodes the THAP9 protein, which is homologous to the Drosophila P-element transposase (DmTNP) and can cut and paste DNA. However, the exact functional role of THAP9 is unknown. Here, we perform structure prediction, evolutionary analysis and extensive in silico characterization of THAP9, including predicting domains and putative post-translational modification sites. Comparison of the AlphaFold-predicted structure of THAP9 with the DmTNP CryoEM structure, provided insights about the C2CH motif and other DNA binding residues, RNase H-like catalytic domain and insertion domain of the THAP9 protein. We also predicted previously unreported mammalian-specific post-translational modification sites that may play a role in the subcellular localization of THAP9. Furthermore, we observed that there are distinct organism class-specific conservation patterns of key functional residues in certain THAP9 domains.
abstract_zh: THAP9是一个由转座子衍生而来的基因，编码THAP9蛋白，该蛋白与果蝇P元件转座酶（DmTNP）同源，能够进行DNA的剪切和粘贴。然而，THAP9的确切功能作用尚不清楚。在此，我们对THAP9进行了结构预测、进化分析及广泛的计算机模拟表征，包括预测结构域和可能的翻译后修饰位点。将AlphaFold预测的THAP9结构与DmTNP的冷冻电镜结构进行比较，揭示了THAP9蛋白中C2CH基序及其他DNA结合残基、RNase H样催化结构域和插入结构域的相关见解。我们还预测了先前未报道的、可能影响THAP9亚细胞定位的哺乳动物特异性翻译后修饰位点。此外，我们观察到在THAP9的某些结构域中，关键功能残基存在明显的生物类别特异性保守模式。
